verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird ships client-facing digital tools, so the axis applies. However, the documented generators (SCC, Term Sheet) are driven by step-by-step interactive questionnaires built on Contract Express, not natural-language commands. The Legora 'Generative AI legal assistant' is a single collaboration mention that never says users can operate anything through natural-language commands, nor that clients can use it. No llms.txt or API surface was found either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
